standard_prerequisites.name: Finite type spaces over a Nagata base are Nagata

standard_prerequisites.name: Normalization of a Nagata space is finite
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, lemma nagata-normalization (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the normalization X'' -> X' finite, and with the finite-proper and composition-proper lemmas X'' -> X is proper.

standard_prerequisites.name: Normalization is normal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, lemma normalization-normal (cross-chapter, named)

core_obligations: The blowup morphism X' -> X is proper since X is locally Noetherian, so X' is Nagata by finite-type-nagata.
Because X' is Nagata, its normalization X'' -> X' is finite; composing with the blowup, X'' -> X is proper (finite maps are proper, and properness composes).
The normalization X'' is normal by the normalization lemma, so the normalized blowing up is a normal Nagata algebraic space proper over X.
proof_roadmap: Properness of the blowup; Nagata propagation; finiteness of the normalization; properness composition; normality of the normalization.
difficulty_reason: A citation-chain synthesis whose content is the direction of the chain (blowup proper, then Nagata, then finite normalization, then proper again, then normal); each citation premise is checkable and no single cited lemma states the conclusion.
